sentiment.instructions: On the whole, does the author of this text evaluate what it talks about favorably, unfavorably, or not at all?

criteria.positive: On the whole, the author evaluates what the text talks about favorably, for instance by praising, recommending, supporting or welcoming it.
criteria.neutral: The author does not evaluate anything, or the evaluation is too weak or unclear to call favorable or unfavorable.
criteria.negative: On the whole, the author evaluates what the text talks about unfavorably, for instance by criticizing, mocking, opposing or complaining about it.
